arguments.sql:
SELECT m.mcc AS mcc,
       c.description AS description,
       SUM(f.is_fraud) AS fraud_count,
       COUNT(*) AS labelled_count,
       1.0 * SUM(f.is_fraud) / COUNT(*) AS fraud_rate
FROM transactions t
JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT)
JOIN merchants m ON t.merchant_id = m.id
JOIN mcc_codes c ON m.mcc = c.mcc
GROUP BY m.mcc, c.description
HAVING SUM(f.is_fraud) >= 50
ORDER BY fraud_rate DESC, m.mcc ASC
arguments.explanation: Lists each MCC with at least 50 fraud-labelled transactions, with its fraud count, labelled transaction count and fraud rate over labelled transactions, highest rate first.
assumptions: 'At least 50 transactions labelled as fraud' means SUM(is_fraud) >= 50 per MCC.
Fraud rate = fraud-labelled count / all labelled transactions for that MCC; unlabelled transactions are excluded.
MCC is taken from the merchant's mcc (transactions -> merchants -> mcc_codes), over the full data range 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
